mechanical_guide: Verify exact approved Git blobs and archive explicit user approval
Copy approved PRODUCT.proposed.txt and ROADMAP.proposed.txt into current authority without semantic alterations
Regenerate existing documentation projections; inspect exact allowlist
Run DELIVERY documentation-authority gates and independent exact-SHA review

pre_mortem: Approved design scope confused with completed implementation or live/legal/payment authorization; generated manifest drifts or unrelated local Rust changes imported.
blast_radius: Two current-authority documents and generated projections plus bounded evidence only.
detection: Exact approved source byte comparison, allowed paths, required gates and independent review.
rollback: Revert candidate authority delta through reviewed forward change; preserve approval/design evidence.
stop_conditions: Required check or independent review failure
candidate_rebase_reason: Isolate approved authority change from historical evidence-only design worktree with pre-existing unclassified/broken-link Markdown; preserve that worktree and its validation failures.
